input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this expression is redundant because 古代 already names a time period; use 在古代 for the narrative setting. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在靠墓地的家：住在墓地旁边的家里，了 cannot be placed between the verb and its location phrase; this is a continuing living situation, so use 住在 + place without 了. [teacher rule: le_placement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟：带着，跟孟子搬家 means moving together as companions, while 带着孟子搬家 means that the mother takes her child with her when moving. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，别 cannot be used directly before 一个 to mean “another”; use 另一个 for one different city. [rule: none]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，了 follows the directional/resultative complement, so it comes after 到 rather than before it. [teacher rule: le_placement]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和孟母，孟子 is appearing for the first time, so introduce him as a child with his name before using the family label 孟母. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在一个城市里，那个 assumes that the city has already been identified, but this is its first mention; introduce it with an indefinite noun phrase. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，孟母 was just named, and no other female character competes as the referent, so use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，孟子 has just been referred to as 孩子, so a pronoun is more natural for this close re-occurrence. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，every day describes a routine, so the verb takes the zero particle rather than 了, which marks a completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
11. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 原来买不了房。他们搬到了另一个城市找工作：原来买不了房，所以他们搬到了另一个城市找工作，add 所以 to show the cause-and-effect link between the difficulty and the move. [rule: none]

items.reason: 古代已经表示时间段，按老师的规则不应再说古代的时候。
住了在的了位置错误，而住在墓地旁边的家里是正确的地点表达。
跟孩子搬家本身可以正确地表示母亲和孩子一起搬家，带着只是另一种可行说法。
别一个城市不符合这里“另一个城市”的用法，另一个城市正确。
趋向补语到后面才能放完成体了，搬到了正确。
孟子首次出现需要作较明确的介绍，但所示改写接回原句后仍保留住了在的错误。
城市尚未被提及，那个城市的指称不清楚，在一个城市里可以首次引入。
孟母刚刚出现且没有其他女性竞争指称，按老师的近距离复现规则应使用她。
孩子不能清楚指明这里是孟子；前句刚提到孟子，用他可以明确且自然地指代他。
每天表示日常重复行为，按规则应使用零体标记，不用完成体了。
老师指出搬家的原因不是买不了房，加入所以反而保留并强化了错误的因果信息。
